definition: Unemployment refers to the share of the labor force that is without work but available for and seeking employment.
Unemployment youth refers to the share of the labor force ages 15-24 without work but available for and seeking employment.
Annual percentage growth rate of GDP at market prices based on constant local currency.
GDP per capita is gross domestic product divided by midyear population.
Annual percentage change in consumer price indices as measured by the consumer price index.
Labor force participation rate is the proportion of the population ages 15 and older that is economically active.
Total population is based on the de facto definition of population, which counts all residents regardless of legal status.
Unemployment rate, male (% of male labor force)
